title: Edward Teller on the UFO legacy program

tellings.quote: I vaguely remember some people suggesting that Edward Teller maybe was one of the maybe one of the physicists who if he if there is this legacy program he would be one

plain: A man called Max, speaking as a witness on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he vaguely remembers people suggesting that the physicist Edward Teller might have been involved in a so-called legacy program, meaning a hidden, long-running government effort said to study UFO material. Max says that if such a program exists, Teller would be one of the scientists in it, which would put a famous name at the heart of the secret.
